messages:
Alex: main CI went red immediately after the merge from feature/kvcache-fix — failing step integration/gpu-smoke. Logs show OOM on runner-gpu-7. :eyes: anyone around to grab this?
ci-bot: Build 7202401234 · stage gpu-smoke failed · exit code 137 · artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/7202401234/logs · (auto message)
Maria: @Alex on it, pulling logs now. Do we know if that merge changed batch sizes or model weights?
Alex: no weight changes, mostly tiny refactor. pinging the author @Sam to double-check.
Sam: I didn't touch GPU config. Quick skim — runner startup had an odd env set for CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES in the container entrypoint. Will check container logs.
Jen: if it's a single runner flake we can rerun on a different host: `/ci rerun 7202401234 --stage=gpu-smoke --node=runner-gpu-2`
Oncall: I'm online, can kick the rerun. Recommend rerun + a bisect over the last 3 commits to isolate. Also consider temporarily increasing test mem limit.
Sam: agree. Maria, can you fetch the failed container logs and dmesg so we can confirm OOM vs soft-failure? Alex, can you start a bisect job?
Maria: short snippet from container log: `OOM killer invoked pid=1234 python3` and `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 12345678 bytes` — uploading full logs to artifacts.
Alex: starting bisect: `/ci bisect --range=HEAD~3..HEAD --test=gpu-smoke` (job created).
ci-bot: Bisect job queued · https://ci.redwood/internal/bisect/7202401234 · status: queued
Oncall: rerun kicked on runner-gpu-2. I'll monitor; should finish ~6m.
Sam: for the try job I'll add `export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:64` as a mitigation to see if fragmentation is the issue.
Maria: full heap trace looks like fragmentation + slightly larger tensors — also saw `BATCH_SIZE=32` in the test harness env. Could the refactor have increased intermediate buffer lifetimes?
Alex: if bisect points at a specific commit we'll revert or patch immediately. Keeping this thread for updates — thanks everyone :pray:
